Welcome to the **Thinghood Limited** interactive studies environment. This platform hosts our core theoretical curriculums and problem sets, mapping the philosophical implications of a Monistic Universe into rigorous mathematical and categorical semantics. --- ::: {.card .text-white .bg-primary .mb-4} ::: {.card-header} **Latest Curriculum Update** ::: ::: {.card-body}

NF Set Theory & Categorical Semantics

A granular, 7-part exhaustive deep dive into Quine's New Foundations (NF) and Categorical Logic. This module explores the structural mechanics of a Monistic Universe (where the universal set $V$ exists), the failure of Cartesian Closedness, and the mapping of these realities to JSON ontologies using Stratified Pseudo Elephants and C-Monoids.

Start the Deep Dive ➔ ::: ::: --- ## 📚 Study Categories ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .mb-4} ::: {.card .h-100} ::: {.card-body}

NF Set Theory

Foundations & Topology

Explore the foundational axioms of Quine's New Foundations, the algebraic mechanization by Hailperin, and the topological crises identified by Specker and Orey.

View Module ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .mb-4} ::: {.card .h-100} ::: {.card-body}

Categorical Semantics

Morphisms & Logic

Shift from element-based structures to arrow-based categorical semantics. Investigate Lawvere's ETAC, Cartesian Closed Categories, and the translation of logical deductions into morphisms.

View Module ::: ::: ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .mb-4} ::: {.card .h-100} ::: {.card-body}
